review_notes: I read the whole file and compared its new definitions with Mathlib. The definitions are Finset.dfinsupp, DFinsupp.singleton, DFinsupp.rangeIcc, DFinsupp.pi and instLocallyFiniteOrder. I grepped Mathlib for competing definitions and found none for DFinsupp. The Finsupp counterparts in Mathlib/Data/Finsupp/Interval.lean (Finset.finsupp, Finsupp.rangeIcc) are parallel constructions on a different type, so they are not duplicates. DFinsupp.singleton and DFinsupp.pi might be expressible through DFinsupp.mapRange with the pointwise Zero on Finset. That would be a generic-map implementation of a named API, which the rubric does not count as a defect. I found no concrete cost such as duplicated substantive API or repeated conversions, so I abstain. The remaining uncertainty is that I did not search exhaustively for downstream uses of DFinsupp.singleton.
